observations.claim: In Amendment No. 4 to Schedule 13D filed July 6, 2026 (event date June 30, 2026), Sylebra-affiliated reporting persons disclosed aggregate beneficial ownership of 19,392,411 AEVA shares, or approximately 29.3% calculated on a diluted Rule 13d-3 basis: 16,240,671 existing shares and 3,151,740 shares issuable on conversion of $50 million 4.375% convertible notes. The 29.3% figure is not equivalent to 29.3% currently issued shares/votes; the notes were not planned for immediate conversion.

Item 6 states that the standstill provisions of the June 2022 Sylebra letter agreement ceased to be effective after the Sylebra-designated director resigned from Aeva's board in May 2025. This is distinct from whether other contractual nomination rights remain effective and must not be treated as proof of their termination.

limitations: The filing establishes reporting-person beneficial ownership as of June 30, 2026, not ownership at October 2026 or actual conversion of the notes.
No governance score, board-control determination, underwriting conclusion, or adjudication is made.

methodology: Methodology 1.0 preserved; append-only source acquisition; Beast/integrity gates and Earth Core canonical authority unchanged.
